phone.notes: New: the info screen of a Digimon shows its vitals, trophies, fights and win rate at the top. Fixed: the Transfer item only moves real white points, new forms without a card show in Storage, up to 3 plots per player, and the Digital World button opens the open world. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: Fix: the steps of an adventure count again. The walk could stay at 0 / 1000 while encounters kept coming, because it used a rough accelerometer guess if you started it right after opening the app. It now always uses the step counter of the watch.

phoneStore.notes: Fix: the Mini Coliseum (30000 coins) has its own name in the build menu instead of a second "House". Requires Android 13 or newer.
